import axiosInstance from"core/services/api/axiosInstance";const base_url=process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL;const API_URL=`${base_url}address-townships`;// Get addressTownships
const getAddressTownships=async(access_token,params=null)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${access_token}`},params};const response=await axiosInstance.get(API_URL,config);return response.data;};// Create new addressTownship
const createAddressTownship=async(addressTownshipData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL,addressTownshipData,config);return response.data;};// update addressTownship
const updateAddressTownship=async(addressTownshipId,addressTownshipData,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.put(API_URL+"/"+addressTownshipId,addressTownshipData,config);return response.data;};// Delete addressTownship
const deleteAddressTownship=async(addressTownshipId,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.delete(API_URL+"/"+addressTownshipId,config);return response.data;};// batch delete addressTownships
const batchDeleteAddressTownships=async(addressTownshipIds,token)=>{const config={headers:{Authorization:`Bearer ${token}`}};const response=await axiosInstance.post(API_URL+"/batch-delete",addressTownshipIds,config);return response.data;};const addressTownshipService={getAddressTownships,createAddressTownship,updateAddressTownship,deleteAddressTownship,batchDeleteAddressTownships};export default addressTownshipService;
